# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the checks, tests, hardware, or fixtures used.

## Protocol and compatibility

- [ ] No wire protocol changes
- [ ] Protocol changes include schemas, golden traces, and an ADR

## Security and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, private audio, transcripts, or local paths are included
- [ ] I have the right to submit all code and assets
- [ ] Third-party material and licenses are identified
- [ ] This change does not copy cc-connect source, protocol fields, configuration,
      tests, documentation, UI, icons, or assets

## Licensing

- [ ] Dependency and SBOM documentation is updated when required
- [ ] Commits include the DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer
